headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: Detection issue seen AGAIN at Kramer/Metric for vehicles on EB Kramer going straight. This is probably the 4th or 5th SR for this issue and the detection gets adjusted each time. Observed at 4:24PM on 9/19/26. Hitting the ped button makes it go green. Please email me for additional details if needed

Absolutely absurd how loud this music is.  It’s playing from a roof top with speakers facing up and the base is the worst! I am 3 blocks away high up and can hear it clearly.  This has to be a noise violation and I’m sick of hearing this every night!

3 lights are out at Little Zilker Tennis courts. These need to be replaced ASAP. The city is not doing their due diligence with routine maintenance. I reported this when 2 lights were out and you came back with it needs to be 3. That in itself is ridiculous.

There used to be a very nice metal trashcan that the plastic trashcan went inside of and months, maybe a year ago it was taken away and never replaced. since then the plastic trashcan has lived on its own underneath the poop bag sign. Please replace the metal trash can. Apologies for my punctuation. I’m walking my dog. Thanks!

The traffic signal for northbound S Pleasant Valley Rd at E William Cannon Dr needs to be reviewed. With the current construction and lane closure, the green light for traffic going straight is very short and only allows approximately 3–4 vehicles through before turning red. Please review the signal timing and consider extending the green-light duration while construction is ongoing.

The utility work associated with the attached permit was started and extended beyond the original deadline with no notice to the neighborhood. 

This roadwork is blocking access to my business from 6th Street via Walsh and we’re down 40%-50% per day since this construction started. 

When we installed our utilities, we had to work overnight and restore traffic access during the day. This work need

Please don’t direct dangerous traffic through Santa Monica Dr, 78741, while performing construction on Burleson Rd. This street has a hill that obstructs visibility and this neighborhood is not designed for traffic racing through in both directions. Previously when you sent main street traffic through our neighborhood my parked car was totaled by someone speeding through the street. Prior to that

It’s 1:28am and impossible to sleep!  Bars on W 6th so loud and bass so heavy we can feel it pulsing in our chests. What good is enforcement if all they can do is refer to APD.  That was our only recourse in the past and we all know that meant no sound enforcement.

Alley street light out. Please replace with the older style warm/yellow lights, not the cool/blue lights. It’s right outside my bedroom window, and the warm light is much easier to block/not absurdly bright. Thank you!

Watr Rooftop Lounge at 1 Hotel emmits rooftop sound & bass that hits 24th-fl high-rise units directly. Vibrates interior walls/windows from 7PM nonstop. Violates Austin Code Ch. 9-2 structural vibration rule at any hour. Request Sound Enforcement measure low-frequency dBC from street & factor in altitude projection.  Venue must install proper sound deadening material

There are several light/electric poles around my business that have either graffiti or some attempt to cover graffiti. It’s my understanding the city will come and remediate. If we can get this done as soon as possible I would appreciate it. Thank you!

There needs to be something to block vehicles from the shared use path.  It is so wide that there is regularly vehicles parked here.  Sometime we get two abreast!  There’s plenty of parking on the property

Excessive rooftop bass coming from Watr at 1 Hotel physically vibrating walls/windows throughout my entire apt on the 24th floor of The Quincy. Violates Austin Code Ch.9-2 structural vibration rule. DbC measurements need to be adjusted upward for high altitude projection. The venue is empty also no reason for this volume.

lost/loose dog on northcrest & crestland. he’s been living at 207, the house on the corner, mainly hiding in their front yard. they are aware but not the owners of the dog. i’ve tried to leash him a couple of times but he’s very scared and got away. he’s probably 10lbs, black longhair chihuahua. treat motivated. likely very hungry and dehydrated. neighbors have seen him for the past week

2 loose medium brown dogs chasing aggressively we were riding bikes. A car was behind us and they still chased us and blocked the road almost getting ran over the car honked and the dogs didn’t move. These dogs chased us all the time and one has bitten me and has been reported. These people need to contain their dogs

Lexington hills apartments. 2430 Cromwell Cir Apt 1708. Turtle kept on balcony in direct sunlight. Looks like this turtle has been forgotten about. Been outside for at least 2 weeks. I called the complex on Friday and they said they’d take care of it. Turtle is still there boiling in 100° weather in standing still water. They should have left this turtle in its own habitat. Please don’t close this

Subject: Urgent Safety Hazard: Broken Picnic Tables at Gullett School Park
The wooden picnic tables at the Gullett grounds are severely warped, rotting, and heavily splintered. They pose an immediate injury risk to elementary students and neighborhood children. Please inspect the site immediately to tape off or remove the hazardous tables, and schedule replacements using durable, splinter-free mat

There is a homeless encampment behind our neighbors house at 5310 Suburban Drive. This person refuses to leave and it is on a green belt. Our neighbor was robbed at her prior residence and this is making them fearful of being in their own house/backyard. Thank you for you help. A prior service request (260-030-2271) has been made but nothing has happened. Public camping on parkland, greenbelts, an

A Malibu is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed.  This car needs to be towed. Thanks.

Traffic light on dessert willow loop and 1626 is not visible to drivers.
East bound traffic barely has enough time to slow down after turning a blind turn on a busy intersection. 

This is especially an issue when the light is red resulting to drivers having to abruptly break their vehicles.

There needs to be an officer or someone to monitor the area. I saw a Nir head on collision between a school bus disobeying the rule and a car.

This vehicle is still there, unmoved. It is obstructing lines of sight for exiting vehicles and those approaching from the west.

Please help us move this vehicle that is creating a road hazard unnecessarily

This dog (Casper or Gasper?) is constantly out of its yard. There have been attempts from neighbors to talk to the owners about securing their fence but they’ve been rude. This has gone on for a year. People with dogs on leash who are not dog friendly can’t walk the neighborhood. 6121 Perlita is his home

When driving on E 12th crossing Chicon, Chicon is higher than E 12th, causing vehicles to experience a significant bump while crossing. Even if the bump can’t be fixed, can a bump warning sign or road hump pavement marking be added to warn drivers?

The city is excessively pruning the beautiful trees of Mayfield Park! This is a sad and outrageous situation. Please send a qualified arborist immediately

There is a restaurant located directly across from a residential building “Watr” that plays loud music from Thursday through Sunday, typically between 6 PM and 2 AM. The music is currently extremely loud and can be clearly heard inside the my apartment.
Adress: 96 Red River St, Austin, TX 78701
Name: Watr

Even if the music isn’t loud, the bass is excessive and can be felt in every room of my apartment. I do my best to look over how obnoxious the music is on this street and how often the bars do not respect the decibel limits…. But the pounding bass is enough to make me want to KMS. Pls. Do something.

Hello yes. Construction debris and dirt in the road way. This is COA jurisdiction, corner of Falkland trace in the road way on the side of property. Over 2 weeks now. Residents can’t park or use the road way. Previous ticket closed in error. This whole neighborhood is city of Raleigh proper.

This must be a joke. The white bag with two squirrels is visible from one mile. What does “animal not found mean???”
Here is a photo so you do not miss it next time. Wasted time

Bike lane violation  — again this car is in the bike lane. Nearly got hit trying to avoid it. If you want bicyclists to not get hit by cars this is an obvious infraction and way to avoid deaths to bicycles!

The sound levels coming from cabana Club are consistently exceeding the permitted 85-decibel cap when measured from the closest property line near the adjacent residences. The excessive volume is disrupting the peace of the surrounding neighborhood.

Repetitive and excessive bass coming from the Watr Rooftop Pool Lounge at the 1 Hotel nonstop for the last 4 hours. Plz ask them to limit the bass/low freq or install proper sound detonating material. I live in The Quincy and can hear throughout my entire unit

Excessively and unnecessarily loud outdoor music coming from Electric Shuffle located on the first floor of The Quincy at 91 Red River Street. I live on the 24th floor and can hear it throughout my entire unit. They are not even open to the public tonight, and don’t have outside service so it’s completely pointless. I work in nightlife so I totally understand, but this is completely unnecessary. I

Off-leash pitbull being accompanied by owner walking far behind; Pitbull runs up into front/side yards and is chasing squirrels in the street. Owner has been confronted twice to stop and advised that his acitivies are illegal: middle-aged Latino dog is black Pit mix with white toes.

We have directly notified the owners that their dog is getting loose, but the problem has continued. They allow it to leave freely from their home and yard.

The dog also repeatedly enters our yard and defecates there. This is an ongoing issue rather than a single incident.

I am requesting that Animal Protection investigate the repeated failure to keep the dog under restraint pursuant to Austin C

There is a dog that has been left out on a second floor apartment balcony and I can hear it continuously crying and whining. I am unsure of how long the dog has been left out on the balcony, but it is almost 100 degrees.
